title: Integral identity clause for normalized ring refinement maps
statement:
theorem integral_normalized_ring_refinement_identity
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{max u v}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{max u v}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (R : CoefficientConstructionRing.{u, v} l Ω D hl (f := f))
    (F : CoefficientConstructionFields.{u, v} l Ω D hl R)
    (M : CoefficientConstructionCommon.{u, v} l Ω D hl R F)
    (N : CoefficientConstructionRefinements.{u, v} l Ω D hl R F M)
    (E : FieldStage.{max u v} l) :
    ∀ c : Compactification f, (N.refinement (.id c) (.integral E)).left = Iso.refl _

proof.text: Apply the identity specialization of the normalized integral proper/open mate calculation to the supplied refinement comparison. The open adjunction transpose and the integral-left realization identify its image under the faithful integral coefficient inclusion with the identity map on every object.
